description: React component for the sidebar team menu in Mattermost, including menu items for inviting users, managing team settings, viewing members, managing groups, leaving or joining teams, creating new teams, and plugin integrations.

methods.name: SidebarTeamMenu
methods.description: Main React component rendering the sidebar team menu with various options based on permissions and team state.

methods.name: InvitePeopleMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to open modal for inviting people to the team.

methods.name: AddGroupsToTeamMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to open modal for adding groups to the team.

methods.name: TeamSettingsMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to open team settings modal.

methods.name: ManageViewMembersMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to view or manage team members.

methods.name: ManageGroupsMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to manage team groups.

methods.name: LeaveTeamMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to leave the current team.

methods.name: JoinAnotherTeamMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to navigate to team selection page.

methods.name: CreateTeamMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item to create a new team, with restrictions based on license and usage.

methods.name: RestrictedIndicatorForCreateTeam
methods.description: Component showing restriction info for creating multiple teams during trial or paid plans.

methods.name: LearnAboutTeamsMenuItem
methods.description: Menu item linking to Mattermost Academy for learning about teams.

methods.name: PluginMenuItems
methods.description: Renders plugin-provided menu items in the team menu.
